title: SAPD: Learning from Agent Experience without Environment Interaction
abstract: arXiv:2610.27847v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scaling the training of Large Language Model (LLM) agents typically requires a large collection of executable environments, whose construction, maintenance, and operation constrain the expansion of training experience. Existing offline trajectories offer an opportunity to reuse interaction experience, yet effectively refining the current policy without revisiting these environments remains challenging: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can lead to catastrophic forgetting, while online reinforcement learning requires real-time interaction with the environment. To address this challenge, we propose Step-Advantage Policy Distillation (SAPD), a method for learning from offline trajectories using relative step advantages. translated_title: SAPD：无需环境交互的智能体经验学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.27847v1 公告类型：新 摘要：扩展大语言模型（LLM）智能体的训练通常需要大量可执行环境，而这些环境的构建、维护和运行限制了训练经验的扩展。现有的离线轨迹为复用交互经验提供了机会，然而在不重新访问这些环境的情况下有效改进当前策略仍然具有挑战性：监督微调（SFT）可能导致灾难性遗忘，而在线强化学习需要与环境进行实时交互。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了步级优势策略蒸馏（SAPD），这是一种利用相对步级优势从离线轨迹中学习的方法。SAPD将多轮轨迹分解为单个决策上下文以进行在线策略蒸馏，使学生模型能够基于记录的历史生成响应，并引入相对步级优势信号来……
tldr: 该论文提出步级优势策略蒸馏（SAPD）方法，通过将离线多轮轨迹分解为单步决策上下文进行在线策略蒸馏，并利用相对步级优势信号，使LLM智能体无需与环境交互即可从离线经验中有效学习，同时避免了SFT的灾难性遗忘和在线强化学习对实时环境交互的依赖。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Step-Advantage Policy Distillation (SAPD), which decomposes offline multi-turn trajectories into individual decision contexts for on-policy distillation and introduces relative step advantage signals, enabling LLM agents to effectively learn from offline experience without environment interaction, avoiding both catastrophic forgetting from SFT and the real-time environment interaction required by online reinforcement learning.
